cases.schema:
spec:
  identity:
    atomic_ref: "cic:core:Identity@v0.2.0"
    kind: Demo
    namespace: "cic:demo"
    version: v1.0.0
  config_surface:
    aggregate_ref: "cic:core:ConfigSurface@v0.2.0"
    nodes:
      - name: type
        shape_type: scalar
        scalar_type: string
        mandatory: true
      - name: enabled
        shape_type: scalar
        scalar_type: boolean
        optional: true
        default: true
      - name: mtu
        shape_type: scalar
        scalar_type: integer
        optional: true
        default: 1500
      - name: label
        shape_type: scalar
        scalar_type: string
        optional: true
        default: x
      - name: note
        shape_type: scalar
        scalar_type: string
        optional: true
      - name: maybe
        shape_type: scalar
        scalar_type: string
        optional: true
        nullable: true
        default: d
      - name: ip
        shape_type: composite
        optional: true
        nullable: true
        fields:
          - name: gateway
            shape_type: scalar
            scalar_type: string
            optional: true
            default: 10.0.0.1
          - name: prefix
            shape_type: scalar
            scalar_type: integer
            optional: true
            role: config
            default: 24
      - name: tags
        shape_type: collection
        collection_variant: set
        item_scalar_type: string
        optional: true
        role:
          authority: config
        default: [a]
      - name: servers
        shape_type: collection
        collection_variant: set
        item_scalar_type: string
        optional: true
        default: []
      - name: routes
        shape_type: collection
        collection_variant: list
        optional: true
        item_fields:
          - name: to
            shape_type: scalar
            scalar_type: string
            role: key
          - name: metric
            shape_type: scalar
            scalar_type: integer
            optional: true
            default: 10
          - name: via
            shape_type: scalar
            scalar_type: string
            optional: true
